Anna / Jonas —

Attached is our legal team's redline (RI_DPA_redline_legal.docx) and a current subprocessors snapshot (subprocessors_snapshot_20260612.csv). Highlights and suggested language:

1) SCCs/IDTA: We will attach the EU SCCs and a UK Addendum (IDTA-style) as separate exhibits. Proposed clause (new):
   "Provider will make available the EU SCCs and the UK Addendum as separate annexes to this DPA. Where a law requires additional safeguards for UK/EU transfers, Provider will promptly provide reasonable evidence of technical and organizational measures."

2) Transfer-impact language (short form we prefer):
   "Where Controller requires transfer impact information, Provider will supply, within 10 business days, a written summary of transfer safeguards reasonably available to Provider, including copies of relevant annexes and the current subprocessors list."

3) Subprocessors notice period: We cannot commit to a universal 30-day notice for all categories. Proposed workable compromise: 30 days for commercial SaaS subprocessors; 7-15 days for cloud infra changes where operational security constraints exist (we'll notify and provide mitigation details).

4) Liability/indemnity: we preserved existing caps and did not accept broad new indemnities in the redline — see §9.

If FinServ can accept these positions we can finalize and initiate DocuSign routing.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
